race.comment: VARUNI (6) lightly raced mare who looks destined for better company. Returned from a spell with a dominant win over 1280m at Muswellbrook with the 58.5kg. Can race a touch closer today as she steps up in class. Hard to stop. ZOUSANITY (7) made it back-to-back wins from outside gates and looks primed for this. Speared across from the wide draw with a commanding 3 len win over 1250m at Gunnedah. Best figures measure up and sure to run well. READY AND LUCKY (4) returns from a let-up after she came to town with a respectable fifth over 1500m at Rosehill in Highway company. Kept up to the mark with a 1000m trial placing and her best form is over this trip. RIVER PAT (5) mixing her form and backs-up quickly after running fourth over 1200m at Gosford. Worth thought in this class.
